page_title: ATM 2-1 ALM | Atletico Madrid v Almeria 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+4' There's an opportunity for Sergio Arribas (Almeria) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
90+1' Koke (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea had an easy-decision to make.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
86' Substitution. Lucas Robertone makes his way off the pitch and Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) comes on as his replacement.
85' Here is a change. Alejandro Pozo is going off and Gaizka Garitano gives the last tactical orders to Arnau Puigmal (Almeria).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Largie Ramazani (Almeria) comes onto the pitch so that Adrian Embarba can be given a rest.
83' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
82' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 10:16. 4:5 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
79' The ball goes out of play and Almeria have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) gets inside the box and tries to beat Jan Oblak with a measured shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
78' Almeria quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
76' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
76' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
76' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for Atl. Madrid.
75' Samuel Lino goes off the pitch and Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
75' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Angel Correa walks off the pitch to be replaced by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
75' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Cesar Azpilicueta is replaced by Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid).
74' Almeria force their opponents to concede a corner.
74' Almeria have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

73' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Jan Oblak is alert and denies him with a nice save. Almeria have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

69' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
68' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
67' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atl. Madrid.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Almeria comes to nothing.
65' A lofted cross from Leo Baptistao (Almeria) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Almeria get a corner.
62' 2 - 1 Goal! Leo Baptistao (Almeria) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
62' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Dion Lopy (Almeria) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
61' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Rodrigo de Paul and he is replaced by Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid).
60' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alvaro Morata.
59' Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
58' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
57' The ball is cleared after Adrian Embarba (Almeria) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
54' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
53' What a save from Jan Oblak! Adrian Embarba (Almeria) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
52' Dion Lopy (Almeria) makes a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Atl. Madrid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
50' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) passes the ball onto Marcos Llorente, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
48' Flag goes up against Sergio Akieme (Almeria) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
47' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
47' A quickly taken corner by Almeria.
47' The attendance for today's match is 55473.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+4' What a poor attempt! Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
45+1' Great save! Adrian Embarba (Almeria) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Jan Oblak.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
41' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Almeria.
41' Almeria take a short corner kick.
40' Almeria take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Almeria force a corner. They send men into the box.

40' Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The linesman makes the right call and Almeria will have a corner.
40' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Almeria.
40' The referee points to the corner flag and Almeria will take a corner.
38' Almeria take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
37' A player from Atl. Madrid commits a rough challenge. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
35' Corner kick. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity.

35' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Luis Maximiano pulls off a great save to stop his attempt towards the top left corner. Good work from Atl. Madrid as they win a corner.
34' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea interrupts the game. One of the players from Almeria won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Atl. Madrid win a free kick.
33' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea saw the whole situation.
32' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
32' Neat passing move from Atl. Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
29' The free kick is taken by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), but ball is cleared.
28' Dion Lopy (Almeria) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
27' Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for an infringement.

25' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
24' Atl. Madrid enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
22' 2 - 0 Goal! Marcos Llorente puts the ball across the area and Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 2:0.
21' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

17' 1 - 0 Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) weaves his way past several defenders and finds himself in a one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy throws the keeper off balance and he simply puts the ball into the back of net.

17' Rodrigo de Paul plays a lovely pass into Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
15' A pass from Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by Luis Maximiano and the move breaks down.
14' The referee blows his whistle as Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in his challenge.
13' Cesar Montes (Almeria) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
11' Cesar Montes (Almeria) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
10' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
9' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
8' Celebrations are cut short for Atl. Madrid as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
7' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Atl. Madrid players aren’t happy.
6' Fantastic team goal! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) was set free in the area by Samuel Lino and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the right side of the net. 1:0.
4' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged offside.
2' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Almeria will have the kick-off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea will officiate today.
